test_title: PYST 43 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: One of these words is spelled incorrectly. Which one is it?
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Perserverance is incorrectly spelled.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Perserverance** in Option 3 is incorrectly spelled.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **Perseverance**, which means persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success.
 
• The other words — **Magnanimous**, **Vehement**, and **Recalcitrant** — are correctly spelled and valid English words.

Correct Answer: *The word **Perseverance** should replace the incorrect spelling **Perserverance**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Magnanimous:** Generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival or less powerful person.
 
• **Vehement:** Showing strong feeling; forceful, passionate, or intense.
 
• **Recalcitrant:** Having an obstinately uncooperative attitude toward authority or discipline.
